events.what: Schlutzenberg proves ZF + an elementary embedding j:V_{λ+2}→V_{λ+2} (λ even) is consistent relative to ZFC + I0
McCallum claims ZF refutes a nontrivial Σ1-elementary j:V_{λ+3}→V_{λ+3}; withdrawn by the author in v3 after finding an error
events.credibility_reason: Withdrawn by the author (v3, 2026-08-23) after an error in the continuity-of-Skolem-functions argument.

judgement.doubts: Schlutzenberg's result is first posted in 2020 (arXiv 2006.01077, same title); the record gives no evidence that v4 (2024-03-18) contains new mathematics, only calling it 'decisive'. Even if v4 were counted, consistency of a V_{λ+2} embedding is a necessary condition for, not a restriction of, the V→V question: it settles a weaker statement and does not decide the bullet in any sub-case, so it is a variant. Journal publication and the 2026 Hausdorff Medal make it digested, but that does not change scope.

corrections.why: F7 + other (scope): the record says Schlutzenberg's paper was 'originally posted 2020' with the same title and result; v4 is a revision with no recorded new mathematics, so the event predates the snapshot. Also, per the record's own competing_reading, consistency of j:V_{λ+2}→V_{λ+2} is a weaker, necessary-condition statement — a variant, not a case that settles any restriction of whether j:V→V can exist. McCallum's 2026 claim was withdrawn (knocked down). Nothing survives, and the problem was not resolved before the snapshot, so open.
F14: with status open, direction is null; the record's 'confirmed' referred to a refuted expectation about a weaker statement, not the bullet.
